name: EPIC 201757091

text.card: A red giant 2,436 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 1, give 0.85 solar masses and 10.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,681 K at its surface.
